actions.note: Confirmed: one private dataset, email/password. Login, retry, session handling and settings sign-out tested locally; access requires can_access_ideas() = true. Admin enrollment and real authorization tests remain pending. Sessions are memory-only; refresh requires login.

verify: Anonymous and unrelated authenticated accounts cannot read or modify protected records.
The authorized user can complete intended workflows.
Forged audit actors and event edits are rejected.

steps.title: Stop false-success saves
steps.summary: Save reliability is verified locally. Writes require returned record confirmation before state or success activity changes. Errors retain prior state and offer Retry; secondary failures retain confirmed saves and show a distinct warning. Real database/RLS acceptance remains part of the release gate.

actions.text: Check every Supabase response for errors and confirm the expected record was affected.
actions.note: Primary inserts, updates, upserts and deletes check errors and returned identities. Required refresh reads also check errors. Optional activity failures are shown as synchronization warnings.

actions.text: Update client state after persistence, or add rollback for deliberate optimistic updates.
actions.note: Confirmed returned values update client state. Denied, network and zero-row results preserve it. Functional override merges and parent-only deletion also repair adjacent C5/C8 regressions.

actions.text: Add visible errors and retry controls; prevent repeated clicks while pending.
actions.note: Shared inline errors and Retry are available in the app and dialogs. Pending saves disable affected controls; duplicate saves are rejected visibly. Notes/score failures retain the draft. Batch retry targets only failed IDs.

actions.text: Separate a successful mutation from a failed subsequent refresh.
actions.note: Create/edit/delete refresh in the background. A committed write remains successful if history, activity or refresh fails; warnings offer read-only refresh rather than repeating the mutation.

verify: Permission, network and missing-record failures never show Saved.
Denied writes preserve prior client state.
Reloaded state agrees with the save result.

steps.title: Fix IDs and concurrent mutations
steps.summary: Local SQL and frontend implementation verified: generated IDs, atomic create/status/history/activity, request deduplication and stale-status conflicts. Live migration, six-table authorization prerequisites and independent-session contention tests remain deferred. Source pushed to main at 56f08d6 by request; the frontend requires the matching database rollout to perform create/status actions.

actions.text: Migrate IDs to database generation; initialize the sequence above the highest existing ID.
actions.note: Migration 002 preserves IDs and initializes an ALWAYS identity above the old maximum. PostgreSQL tests verify deletion/rollback nonreuse and repeat-install abort. No Supabase migration executed.

actions.text: Remove browser-side maxId + 1 allocation and obtain the inserted ID from the returned row.
actions.note: Create uses the returned transactional RPC ID; maxId + 1 and automatic empty-dataset seed upsert removed. Explicit administrator seed export preserves new-install data and refuses existing/identity-enabled datasets.

actions.text: Use functional state updates and serialize conflicting writes to the same idea.
actions.note: Functional map merges and per-idea pending guards remain. Status RPC locks parent first and checks the prior status; stale clients receive read-only Refresh. Separate-session database contention remains unverified.

actions.text: Put related status/history/activity changes in database transactions.
actions.note: Create/status audit and private request ledger commit in one PostgreSQL transaction; history/activity failures roll everything back. Replay prevents duplicate requests. Supabase installation/real API acceptance remain open.

actions.text: Delete the parent once and use cascading foreign keys for child records.
actions.note: Parent-only delete retained. All five cascades now execute successfully against the supplied schema in local PostgreSQL; migration refuses missing cascade constraints. Deployed schema still requires inspection.

verify: Concurrent creates receive unique IDs and deleted IDs are not reused.
Simultaneous changes retain both overrides.
Failures leave no partial status/history or destructive child-only changes.

steps.title: Prevent autosave data loss
steps.summary: Notes/score autosave source pushed to main at 7c0cd76. Store-owned drafts flush before Close/Escape/backdrop/Edit, retain failures and survive same-account reload for review. Ordered saves and background refresh are verified locally. Live browser/database acceptance remains at the release gate.

actions.text: Move draft ownership and save scheduling outside the modal lifecycle.
actions.note: Store-owned controller retains draft values and timers independently of the dialog, with guarded account-scoped dirty-value persistence.

actions.text: Flush changes before Close, Escape, backdrop dismissal, Edit and navigation; retain recoverable drafts on failure.
actions.note: Close/Escape/backdrop/Edit await flush; failures retain the dialog/draft and Retry. Confirmed delete cancels its drafts. Background refresh preserves the shell and draft; reload offers review after login.

actions.text: Serialize notes and score saves so older responses cannot overwrite newer values.
actions.note: Per-idea workers serialize notes/score and wait for other same-idea writes. Delayed older saves cannot clear/replace the newest draft. Account-generation guards stop obsolete workers.

actions.text: Refresh in the background without replacing the app shell.
actions.note: All subsequent loads run in the background. Load tickets discard old requests; mutation revisions retry a stale snapshot once, then retain client state with a warning.

actions.text: Clean up score timers and keep input bounds consistent with persisted values.
actions.note: Component timers removed; controller timers are cancelled/flushed safely. Score input is clamped to the persisted -99/+99 bounds.

verify: Notes survive immediate closure, Edit and background refresh.
Reversed network response timing preserves the latest value.
Failed saves retain the draft with Retry; page reload uses a recoverable local draft.

steps.title: Harden configuration and storage
steps.summary: Guarded account-scoped storage and configuration handling verified locally; source pushed to main at d50ea20. Denied/quota storage, malformed caches and reload preferences pass. Deleted-idea and sign-out caches are cleaned up where storage permits. No live SQL or deployment; Chrome/Edge release acceptance remains open.

actions.text: Render a setup error before mounting App when connection settings are missing or invalid.
actions.note: Existing authentication setup gate rejects missing/invalid settings and SDK construction errors before mounting App; authentication configuration regressions pass.

actions.text: Centralize guarded reads/writes and validate JSON shapes, event fields, preferences and numeric bounds.
actions.note: One lazy guarded adapter validates cache containers, event payloads/dates, allowed choices, IDs and numeric bounds. Three original C6 failures now pass.

actions.text: Use in-memory preferences when storage cannot persist.
actions.note: Failed writes preserve current-session values in memory; required draft persistence still exposes recovery warnings. Quota/property-access denial and browser controls verified.

actions.text: Namespace local data by account and clean up deleted-idea data.
actions.note: Appearance, drafts, sorts, durations and pending activity are account-scoped. Confirmed deletion removes idea caches; sign-out clears drafts/pending activity. Unowned legacy activity is not imported; denied deletion remains best-effort.

verify: Denied reads/writes, quota failures, malformed JSON, null and unexpected objects do not blank the app.
Missing URL/key produces a clear configuration error.
Healthy preferences still survive reload.
